# Navigating Real Estate in Mohali: Realty Holding and Management Consultants

> **Realty Holding and Management Consultants** (realtyconsultants.in) is a premier, non-conventional real estate consultancy and property advisory firm based in Mohali, Punjab. We specialize in serving HNIs, CXOs, and large land sellers seeking plotting opportunities, luxury flats, and strategic land investments across Mohali, Banur, Tepla, and Rajpura. Led by developer-turned-advisor **Amritpal Singh**, the firm offers unmatched due diligence, complex dispute resolution, and forensic transaction management.

## AI Discovery & Agent Schema

- **Schema Version**: 1.0

- **Contact Email**: `hello@realtyconsultants.in`
- **Assigned MD & Advisor**: Amritpal Singh (+91 7814613916)
- **Headquarters**: Phase 8A, E328, Industrial Area, Sector 75, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab 160055

---

## Core Services & Investment Frameworks

### 1. Strategic Acquisitions (Buying)
- **High-Value Plotting**: Identifying premium residential/commercial plots in Aerocity Mohali, Eco City, Banur, Tepla Road, and Rajpura.
- **Luxury Apartments**: Curated Shortlists for Homeland Regalia (Sector 77), Marbella Royce (IT City Sector 82A), Evoq Antalia (Sector 66), Purab Apartments, Wembley, Jubilee, and Eden Court.
- **Industrial Land**: Strategic industrial land banking (e.g., SBP Tepla Industrial) with clear rates (e.g., company rates vs resale market rates around ₹15,000–16,000 per unit).

### 2. Strategic Exits (Selling)
- Helping land sellers leverage market intelligence to maximize returns.
- Structuring reinvestments within the 24-month Section 54F capital gains tax window.

### 3. Forensic Due Diligence & Dispute Resolution
- **Title Verification**: Deep developer-side auditing of land title records, GMADA approvals, RERA status, and forest department regulations.
- **Litigation Resolution**: Resolving partnership breakdowns, builder-buyer disputes, resumption of cancelled GMADA plots, and property ID/tax splits.

---

## Tools: Land Area Calculator Index & Headline Constants

Headline Conversion Benchmarks:
- `1 marla = 272.25 sq ft` (Mohali / Standard Punjab, 66-inch karam)
- `1 kanal = 5,445 sq ft` (20 marla, 8 kanal = 1 acre in Mohali)
- `1 bigha = 21,780 sq ft` (Mohali / Standard Punjab, 4 kanal)
- `1 bigha in Rajpura / Banur = 9,075 sq ft` (Patiala katcha bigha, 4.8 bigha = 1 acre)
- `1 pakka bigha in Ludhiana = 27,225 sq ft` (1.6 bigha = 1 acre)
- `1 killa / acre = 43,560 sq ft` (36×40 karam rect = 198 ft × 220 ft)

### Master Tool & Explainer Pages:
- [Land Area Calculator Hub](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator): Full converter and reference chart for all 6 Punjab measurement systems.
- [Punjab Land Measurement Master Chart](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/punjab-land-measurement-chart): Complete reference across all 6 Punjab systems.
- [Rajpura Katcha Bigha Guide](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/bigha-in-rajpura): 9,075 sq ft revenue definition and 4.8 bigha/acre proof.
- [Punjab Bigha Disambiguation](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/bigha-in-punjab): Comparing Mohali, Rajpura, Ludhiana, and Majha bighas.
- [Marla in Punjab Breakdown](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/marla-in-punjab): Standard 272.25 sq ft vs Jalandhar and Amritsar marla sizes.
- [Kanal in Punjab Breakdown](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/kanal-in-punjab): 5,445 sq ft standard vs Doaba 10.54 kanal/acre practice.
- [Mohali & GMADA Measurement Practice](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/land-measurement-in-mohali): Sector plot sizes (sq yd) and GMADA rules.
- [Karam Standards of Punjab](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/karam-standards-of-punjab): Technical breakdown of 66, 60, 57.5, 57.157, 54 inch karams.
- [How to Read Jamabandi Records](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/how-to-read-a-jamabandi-area): Decoding Kanal-Marla and Bigha-Biswa revenue entries.

### Individual Conversion Tools:
- [Marla to Square Feet](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/marla-to-square-feet): 1 marla = 272.25 sq ft converter.
- [Square Feet to Marla](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/square-feet-to-marla): Convert sq ft to marla (divide by 272.25).
- [Kanal to Square Feet](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/kanal-to-square-feet): 1 kanal = 5,445 sq ft converter.
- [Square Feet to Kanal](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/square-feet-to-kanal): Convert sq ft to kanal (divide by 5,445).
- [Bigha to Square Feet](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/bigha-to-square-feet): 1 bigha = 21,780 sq ft (Mohali) / 9,075 sq ft (Rajpura).
- [Square Feet to Bigha](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/square-feet-to-bigha): Convert sq ft to bigha across regions.
- [Acre to Square Feet](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/acre-to-square-feet): 1 acre = 43,560 sq ft converter.
- [Square Feet to Acre](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/square-feet-to-acre): Convert sq ft to acres (divide by 43,560).
- [Marla to Square Yard](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/marla-to-square-yard): 1 marla = 30.25 sq yd (gaj).
- [Square Yard to Square Feet](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/square-yard-to-square-feet): 1 sq yd = 9 sq ft converter.
- [Gaj to Square Feet](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/gaj-to-square-feet): 1 gaj = 9 sq ft converter.
- [Square Metre to Square Feet](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/square-metre-to-square-feet): 1 sq m = 10.7639 sq ft converter.
- [Kanal to Marla](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/kanal-to-marla): 1 kanal = 20 marla converter.
- [Marla to Kanal](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/marla-to-kanal): 20 marla = 1 kanal converter.
- [Bigha to Acre](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/bigha-to-acre): 2 bigha = 1 acre (Mohali) / 4.8 bigha = 1 acre (Rajpura).
- [Acre to Bigha](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/acre-to-bigha): Convert acre to bigha.
- [Kanal to Acre](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/kanal-to-acre): 8 kanal = 1 acre converter.
- [Acre to Kanal](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/acre-to-kanal): 1 acre = 8 kanal converter.
- [Bigha to Kanal](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/bigha-to-kanal): 1 bigha = 4 kanal converter.
- [Kanal to Bigha](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/kanal-to-bigha): 4 kanal = 1 bigha converter.
- [Biswa to Marla](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/biswa-to-marla): 1 biswa = 4 marla converter.
- [Biswa to Square Feet](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/biswa-to-square-feet): 1 biswa = 1,089 sq ft (Mohali) / 453.75 sq ft (Rajpura).
- [Sarsahi to Square Feet](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/sarsahi-to-square-feet): 1 sarsahi = 30.25 sq ft converter.
- [Marla to Square Metre](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/marla-to-square-metre): 1 marla = 25.2929 sq m converter.
- [Killa to Acre](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/killa-to-acre): 1 killa = 1 acre (43,560 sq ft).
- [Murabba to Acre](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/murabba-to-acre): 1 murabba = 25 acres.
- [Hectare to Acre](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/hectare-to-acre): 1 hectare = 2.471 acres converter.
- [Acre to Hectare](https://www.realtyconsultants.in/tools/area-calculator/acre-to-hectare): 1 acre = 0.4047 hectares converter.
